subject: SCIM / SAML attribute matrix + RBAC evidence request for security review
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finwell.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finwell.io
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: user provisioning mappings + RBAC demonstration

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier — FinWell is moving to a formal SIG/SOC 2 assessment and our security team needs a short evidence bundle for how Redwood manages identity and access for customer-admin accounts. High-level ask below:  

1) SCIM: a delta export or recent sync log showing creation/updating of user accounts (including the attribute names you write: e.g. externalId, manager, groups)  
2) SAML: the attribute mapping matrix used for Redwood accounts (which SAML attributes map to which internal fields)  
3) RBAC: a role matrix (admin/reader/developer) and an example of a least-privilege role in action (API token scope or console view)  
4) Audit: a sample of admin activity events (admin-create-user, role-change) for August 2026  

Can you confirm which files you can share and whether any redactions are required? We prefer CSV/PDF/Excel attachments or an S3 link. Target deadline: 2026-09-22.

Appreciate it — Emma
Emma Jones
Security Operations Lead, FinWell
emma.jones@finwell.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finwell.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: user provisioning mappings + RBAC demonstration

Hi Emma — thanks, we can provide those. Quick note on scope and format:  

- SCIM delta: we can share a redacted CSV with only SCIM core attributes (externalId, userName, active, groups) and a timestamped delta log for the requested window. Sensitive PII (email local-parts if required) can be hashed if needed.
- SAML matrix: we will export the current attribute mapping PDF and a sample SAML assertion (redacted) showing attribute names.
- RBAC: role matrix as Excel (role -> permissions/grants) plus a short screencap showing console view for a ‘billing-reader’ role.
- Audit: we can produce a zip containing admin event records for August 2026 (event type, actor, target, timestamp); we will redact IPs per our export policy unless you require them.

We’ll upload artifacts to a shared S3 path and send you links. Two asks for you: (1) confirm if redaction of email local-parts is acceptable, and (2) whether FinWell requires signed attestations or an audit-friendly CSV format.

We’ll target a first bundle by Friday 2026-09-17; follow-ups on scope after that.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finwell.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finwell.io
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: user provisioning mappings + RBAC demonstration

Thanks Karthik — redacting local-parts is fine. For the audit event CSV we need: event_type, actor_email (hashed ok), target_user, timestamp, action_details. IPs can be redacted. No signed attestations required for now, just machine-readable CSVs and a short README describing export steps for reproducibility.

Also: can you include how group-to-role mapping is enforced? We saw a note in the docs about dynamic role mapping but we need a clear example (policy or config snippet) showing group -> role enforcement.

Emma
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finwell.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 14:56:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: user provisioning mappings + RBAC demonstration

Forwarding draft bundle for review. Attachments uploaded to: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/finwell/iam/evidence/2026-09-17/  

Attached (zipped and listed below):
- scim_delta_log_20260910.csv — redacted externalId and userName hashed, includes groups and timestamp column
- saml_attribute_mapping_v1.pdf — full attribute matrix and example assertion with values redacted
- rbac_role_matrix_v3.xlsx — roles, permissions, granted API scopes
- audit-events-2026-08.zip — admin event records (IPs removed)

Regarding group->role enforcement: we included a short README and a config snippet (in the RBAC sheet) showing a policy that maps SCIM group membership to internal roles at provisioning time. Example: groups containing "finwell-admins" -> role:org-admin; groups containing "finwell-billing" -> role:billing-reader. The mapping is applied by the provisioning worker at user-create/update time and enforced by policy checks in the authorization service.

Please take a look and let us know if the format works or if you need the raw logs with a different hash salt.

-Karthik
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finwell.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finwell.io
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: user provisioning mappings + RBAC demonstration

Received and initial thumbs-up after quick review. A couple of follow-ups:  

1) For the SAML mapping PDF — can you include the raw attribute names used in the assertion (we only saw display names)? We need the exact assertion name-format (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:uri vs unspecified) and examples.
2) For the audit events — can you include one example event showing a role-change with before/after role columns? That helps our assessor confirm least-privilege changes.

If you can push these two items by EOD Wednesday 2026-09-22 we should be able to include Redwood’s package in our SIG intake.

Emma
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finwell.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: user provisioning mappings + RBAC demonstration

Emma — adding the two items now.

1) SAML mapping: attached new PDF (saml_attribute_mapping_v1.pdf) contains exact attribute names and the attributeFormat entries we publish. We included one redacted assertion with urn-format attributes.
2) Audit example: added a CSV row in scim_delta_log_20260910.csv and a separate sample row called role-change-example.csv (also in the S3 folder) showing before_role and after_role columns with timestamps and actor_id hashed.

Link to updated bundle: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/finwell/iam/evidence/2026-09-20/ 

If anything else is required, ping me directly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
